title: A recording plays back inside the reader, the video in the floating window driving the text

tasks.title: The replay player - state track, media clock, reader apply, leave and come back
Recording page, lobby list, the replay window and its exclusivity with the call

acs.text: WHEN a room member opens the lobby THE SYSTEM SHALL list the room's ready recordings (title, date, length) with a link to each recording's page `/social/rec/:id`, which shows the title, date, length, Play, Download state and, for whoever may delete it, Delete
scenarios: AC-001 the lobby lists recordings and each has a page

acs.text: WHEN the member presses Play THE SYSTEM SHALL navigate the reader to the recording's first text with `ctx=social.rec.<id>` and open the player in the floating call window (the strip on a phone), loading the media with a progress indication and starting at 0
scenarios: AC-002 Play opens the player in the reader

acs.text: WHILE the recording plays THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the reader at the recorded state for the media's current time (the last keyframe at or before it, with the changes after it applied), through the reader state API with origin `playback` and without persisting, applying one state at a time
scenarios: AC-003 the reader follows the recording

acs.text: WHEN the member pauses, seeks with the scrubber or by 10 seconds, or changes speed (1×, 1.5×, 2×) THE SYSTEM SHALL do the same to the media and the reader together
scenarios: AC-004 pause, seek and speed move media and reader together

acs.text: WHEN the member reads around (local input in the reader) during playback THE SYSTEM SHALL stop moving the reader, keep the media playing, and offer "Back to the recording", which returns the reader to the recording's current point
scenarios: AC-005 reading around and coming back

acs.text: WHEN the page is loaded with `ctx=social.rec.<id>` THE SYSTEM SHALL open the player paused at the start without playing by itself; WHEN the member closes the player THE SYSTEM SHALL stop the media, drop the context and leave the reader where it is
WHEN a replay is opened during a live call, or a call is joined during a replay THE SYSTEM SHALL ask first and close the other on confirmation; the two never share the window
scenarios: AC-007 a replay and a call never share the window

acs.text: WHEN the recording cannot be loaded (not found, not a member, a state track that fails the schema) THE SYSTEM SHALL say so in the window and leave the reader as it was
scenarios: AC-008 a recording that cannot be loaded
